target_customer: Developers and startups needing structured data from websites
problem: Websites often lack APIs, so teams spend time on brittle scrapers. Dashblock used machine learning to turn pages into APIs.
business_model: Usage based API subscription (pricing not found)

founders.name: Maxime Corbani
education: Engineering studies in France and Brazil
previous_startups: Symolia, Paris consulting firm (outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Source is the YC page bio.

founders.name: Hugues Pouillot
founders.background_notes: Product Hunt profile lists him as co-founder and the YC page lists him as founder.

competitors.name: Import.io
competitors.what: No code web data extraction with a REST API
competitors.funding_then: About $32M over several rounds per CB Insights

technical_complexity.rationale: Robust page to API conversion with machine learning is standard engineering with hard parts around site changes and scale.

defensibility.rationale: Established scrapers and open source tools did similar work, and site changes broke extractors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows these firms copying or buying Dashblock.

market_need_then: Demand for web data was shown by funded rivals, but no dated Dashblock traction was found. Product Hunt launch on August 8, 2019 and a Dashblock 2.0 launch on May 5, 2021 reached number one of the day with 447 upvotes.

branding.community_and_virality: Dashblock 2.0 took #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt in May 2021, with 447 upvotes and 102 comments

brand_strength.rationale: Product Hunt success suggests a clear message, but no source shows brand driven growth and the name is generic.

outcome_analysis: Dashblock was a Paris team turning websites into APIs, backed by YC and about $150k per an aggregator. It had a strong Product Hunt relaunch in 2021, yet YC lists it as inactive. An aggregator gives 2022 as an end year, but no shutdown announcement or cause was found, so the cause is not public in the sources found.
notes: The $150k seed rests on one aggregator, village.ai. dashblock.com returned HTTP 403 so the site was not verified. A loot-drop.io page claims a 2022 end year and about $3M burned, treated as weak. Import.io date 2019-02 is the Connotate acquisition date per CB Insights, not the Series B date. Apify omitted because sources were undated.
